note: 3D step 1 (23 Nov night): the captain's cabin at sunset. World axes: x right, y away from the lens, z up, metres. The stern windows in the back wall (y 3.2); the low sun comes in through them toward the lens. Each shot's camera drifts from 'from[0]' to 'from[1]' over the shot (eased), looking at 'at'; focus on a figure's head or a point.

shots.what: the captain at the chart table: he sweeps the papers off it with his hand; they fall
low, three-quarter: the captain turned toward the boy, both arms out, shouting the line
the boy alone, from the captain's eye height looking down at him: he looks down at the captain's boots, points at them, looks up at the captain (beside the lens), answers, grins
the boot on the map, close: it lifts and the red X shows under it
three-quarter, from the thighs up: he looks down at his boot, then at the boy; his face goes red, sweat on his cheek, a sheepish grin, both hands up open
